up: Retrieve all approved drugs (molecules with max_phase = 4 in molecule_dictionary) that have at least one mechanism of action in the drug_mechanism table classified as 'CHELATING AGENT' (action_type). For each such drug, output the drug preferred name, drug ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES from compound_structures, and for each associated target (via drug_mechanism.tid to target_dictionary) output the target preferred name, target type, target organism, and target ChEMBL ID. Show each drug–target combination separately. Do not add any filters beyond those explicitly mentioned.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.pref_name AS drug_name,
    md.chembl_id AS drug_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    td.target_type,
    td.organism,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno
JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE md.max_phase = 4
  AND dm.action_type = 'CHELATING AGENT';
